relationships.subject: fructose diet
relationships.evidence_quote: In response to inflammatory agents, the fructose group displayed significantly enhanced peripheral hyperalgesia and more pronounced paw edema.

relationships.subject: fructose diet
relationships.evidence_quote: fructose not only contributes to the development of obesity and metabolic disorder but also exacerbates peripheral inflammatory pain responses by enhancing prostaglandin sensitivity

key_findings: Fructose-induced metabolic disorder exacerbates carrageenan, LPS and PGE2-induced mechanical hyperalgesia and paw edema in rats.
